findings.issue: No test infrastructure whatsoever: no test script, no runner (vitest/@nuxt/test-utils/playwright), no test files in app/.
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest with @nuxt/test-utils for unit tests and a minimal Playwright config for URL-state/e2e specs; wire a `test` script.

findings.issue: All shared data transforms (humanize, collapseWhitespace, englishName, latestEnglishFlavor, idFromUrl, mediaUrl) are untested pure functions used on every page.
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests for these functions: names with dashes, non-English entries, whitespace runs, sprite URL normalization.

findings.issue: The id < 10000 alternate-forms exclusion guards every Pokémon list; a regression re-adds Mega forms everywhere or empties the dex.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test getDexIndex's filter with a fixture containing species ID 10033 alongside 25.

findings.issue: The sortable-table comparator (missing-values-last in both directions, numeric vs label columns, descending flip, tie-break) plus aria-sort toggling is the highest bug-density component and is untested.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test sortedRows/sortBy with a small rows fixture including null power and duplicate move names; assert aria-sort indirectly via rendered order.

findings.issue: Debounced search watcher and the 'same query' comparison (page deliberately excluded from equality) implement filter-URL semantics with no tests; regressions double-push history or lose filter state.
findings.suggestion: Playwright (or component-mount) tests: typing search replaces URL without page param; back/forward restores filters; repeated identical search does not push.

findings.issue: Selected game defaults to the highest-order available version group and honours ?game only when valid; neither rule is tested.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test getPokemonPage's games/selectedGame output for a fixture Pokémon, including an invalid ?game value.

findings.issue: Move-row dedup key `${method}|${move}|${level}` and the level-up-then-name sort (382-386) are unguarded; a key change duplicates rows in the tables.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with a Pokémon that learns the same move at multiple levels in one version group.

findings.issue: Species reconciliation for move/ability/type pages (mapping deoxys-normal to species deoxys, excluding alternate forms) repeats in three page builders with no shared test.
findings.suggestion: One fixture-driven test per builder asserting a Pokémon-form reference yields the species card.

findings.issue: Cache eviction of rejected promises is the only thing preventing a single upstream 500 from being cached for the process lifetime; a refactor dropping the .catch is silent.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test apiGet: after a failing fetch, a subsequent call retries (with fetch mocked to fail then succeed).

findings.issue: Not-found handling (catch-all with setResponseStatus(404), and each API route returning {found:false}) has no app-owned coverage; upstream 500s fall through to an unstyled Nitro error page.
findings.suggestion: Playwright spec for /pokemon/missingno and one asserting graceful behaviour when the API is unavailable.

summary: The app ships with zero tests of its own — no runner, no script, no files — so every safeguard is the borrowed acceptance suite. All of the genuinely risky logic (the 550-line data-layer transform module, the move-table sort comparator, debounced URL-state sync, pagination clamping, cache failure eviction, and not-found/404 paths) is unguarded. Bugs in any of it will surface only in production or when someone manually re-runs the external tests.
